decisions.reason: Rye country bread fits the firm's established bread-making knowledge and processes closely, so management can learn from early sales with low development risk and improve it within existing capabilities.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen is very close to the firm's confectionery core and the reported gold medal is a strong external quality signal that supports continued commercialization.
Rye mixed bread with seeds builds directly on the firm's existing rye and artisan baking know-how, making it easy to absorb customer feedback and refine without major new capabilities.
Dark barley malt rye bread remains firmly within the firm's related bread expertise, so the product is a manageable extension of current knowledge rather than a risky diversification.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is a close variant of products the firm already masters, allowing it to use existing recipes, seasonal demand knowledge, and production routines effectively.
Ancient grain bread is somewhat more novel in ingredients but still highly related to the firm's bread competencies, giving it a good chance to build new knowledge on top of its existing baking base.
